verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only an official Fivetran MCP server (fivetran-mcp) that lets external AI models query and manage Fivetran. That is the server role, the opposite direction from this story. Nothing shows Fivetran itself acting as an MCP client that can connect to external MCP servers and use their tools. The AI coding-agent plugins and AI support assistant are adjacent features and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
